component.name: Lumo Desktop
component.summary: Unofficial desktop app for Proton Lumo

description.p: Lumo Desktop is an unofficial, community-made desktop shell for Proton's Lumo AI assistant (lumo.proton.me). It is a thin Electron wrapper that loads the official Lumo web app and adds native desktop touches: a system tray icon, a show/hide toggle, native notifications, spellcheck, and portal-based file dialogs. All login, two-factor authentication, and encryption are handled entirely by Proton's own web app running inside the wrapper.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Proton AG. "Lumo" and "Proton" are trademarks of Proton AG.
